summary: The note describes the Sierra Arana, also called Sierra de Arana or Sierra Harana, a mountain range located in the centre of the province of Granada in southern Spain. It identifies the Peña de la Cruz as the range's highest peak.
one_line: Sierra Arana is a mountain range in central Granada province, southern Spain, whose highest peak is the Peña de la Cruz.
key_facts: The Sierra Arana is also known as Sierra de Arana or Sierra Harana.
The Sierra Arana is a mountain range in the center of the province of Granada.
The Sierra Arana is located in southern Spain.
The highest peak of the Sierra Arana is the Peña de la Cruz.
